subject: Org self-evaluation landed (docs/agent/ORG_SELF_EVALUATION_2026-09-12.md) — your assignments, in order; the finding is assignment, not execution
body: The owner asked for a self-evaluation of whether everything is owned, moving and in its channel. Seven independent readers + synthesis + a completeness critic (~1.5M subagent tokens); the report is in the tree at docs/agent/ORG_SELF_EVALUATION_2026-09-12.md with every claim traced. Verdict: the machinery runs (clocks on cadence, mail 111/111, sim 17/17, evidence fresh) but the RECORDS lag the work and the PRODUCT objective has no lane: the seven DR-033 gaps (BUILD_BACKLOG full-evaluation section, 18 rows) and every row DR-040/042/043 opened this week name no lane, and check-backlog-ownership.mjs cannot see them because it reads COMPANY_BUILD_PLAN.md, not BUILD_BACKLOG.md. YOUR LIST, in order (all in the report's 'Assignments' section): (1) stamp a lane on every lane-less BUILD_BACKLOG row (DR-042 joins 1-6, DR-043 Pucks 1-5, DR-040 CLI harness, the three Now rows :259/:277/:390, Trending, api-zod, the 18 full-evaluation rows) and extend check-backlog-ownership.mjs to BUILD_BACKLOG `- [ ] **` rows so a lane-less row fails; propose the DR-042 join order as a one-line amendment. (2) DR-036's named follow-up: bind the 23 launch items to proof:* names in scripts/launch-profile.mjs and make dimension (b) a ratio — today (b) is binary and read 0 for hours after each of five manifest moves. (3) Roster clock: nextActionDate + a REPORTED >7d line in check-org-roster.mjs; mark the seven done nextActions (devex 73, mobile-native dynamic-type + 58, data-persistence SHIFT 2, positioning labels, brand-design DR-006, desktop CI, finance COST_MODEL); set activated on the three FIRST-EXECUTION-DONE roles. (4) Record hygiene in one PR: SOLUTION_READINESS_ASSESSMENT.md still gates on discovery (add the DR-033 paragraph); DR-043's provenance sentence + three moved cites; NOTICE not reconciled since 2026-08-06 while .claude/skills grew to 100 upstream dirs; CONTINUITY.md header-only since 08-22; LEVEL_10 matrix owner columns from July; BRAIN_CYCLE_DESIGN.md:249 still says the tick is awaiting activation. (5) Mis-filed owner items that are engineering: AppWorkflows parity re-port + extend check-decision-port-parity (row 101); open the deletion row for tests/load/, .agents/agent_assets_metadata.toml, site/index.html (the Mac executes); the three 'recorded rather than made' safety defaults — propose fail-closed, owner vetoes. (6) PR #531 (green, idle since 09-10): merge mainline in, preflight + breadth, merge or close as superseded. Also cloud/fix-ci-timeout dcd9cff is NOT on origin — push it as its own PR. (7) lane-deliver: a superseded mail PR should delete its branch on close (22 lane/cloud-* residue branches); add a routine row for the monthly Dependabot queue. (8) Confirm today's scheduled-verification run is green after #645 via #653. (9) Then build: Puck 5, Puck 1 (moves the manifest — batch it, then ONE re-mint request), the smart-charging scenario behind a DR. CRITIC'S ADDITIONS nobody reads: a HIGH CodeQL alert on the /v1 middleware open 55 days with no row (security role); GitHub Pages is build_type=legacy status=errored and the live site is 12 days behind the tree still rendering three of the 53 claims Batch R removed (owner setting + proof-led-content); CI failed on three heartbeat-only mainline pushes in 24h (af80bf16, 689389df, 30e35ef0) — the #657 paths-ignore may not cover every workflow; two private sibling repos unexamined 33 days; firmware/dock has a named role that never ran; the harness's skipped-gate count S is printed but never recorded. DONE MAC-SIDE TODAY: LOOP STATE BLOCKED ON / NEXT ACTION rewritten from the evaluation (they were 7- and 5-day fossils) and the typed readiness number removed; check-readiness-figure.mjs now spawns node --import tsx (it read BROKEN in every sandboxed session); install-crucible.mjs full-id pin; DR-038→DR-040 cite in SKILL_AUTHORING_STANDARD.md; the Graphify row's 'nothing in the tree' corrected. Tell the owner in one line when you read this that the outreach gate is open and which sends are prepared — the evaluation found no board line says so.
